name: CleanSpark
industry_role: crypto-mining company pivoting to AI/HPC data center hosting
notes: Crypto-mining pivot: partnering with immersion-cooling firm Submer; announced $6.6B AI data-center lease (Sandersville, GA, 175MW); marketing 1.8GW contracted-capacity pipeline.
